name: Bank of Lanzhou Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Lanzhou Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services in China. The company offers deposit products; wealth management; and debit and credit card. It is also involved in the provision of syndicated loans, m and a loans, and pledge loans for public deposits; transaction banking and featured services; and settlement, international, and financial market business. In addition, the company provides small and micro enterprise, individual, industrial, commercial, and farmer loans; investment and financial management; and e-banking services. Bank of Lanzhou Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Lanzhou, China.
